title: Material and other details for latrine unit
rows: Horizontal length of pan should be at least 425 mm and longitudinal bottom slope 25 -28°
It should be 70 to 75 mm with 20 mm water seal
It should be 250×125 mm with 15 to 20 mm height
May be non-pressure pipes of PVC minimum 75 mm dia
Material: Ceramic, FRP, PP, HDPE, PVC, Cement mosaic or Cement concrete
Fibre Glass, Ceramic, HDPE or CC traps
Ceramic or concrete with mosaic finish brick or stone
Should conform to IS: 2556 (Pt. III), IS: 11246, GRP Sq. Pan
Should conform to IS: 2556 ( Pt. XIII)
Should conform to IS: 2556 ( Pt. X)
Slope should be 1 in 5 to 1 in 15 as per site conditions
notes: Row 4 of the grid carries only the footnote markers '(A)' (Squatting Pan column) and '(B)' (Connecting Drain column); the two footnotes are printed immediately below the table.

Footnote (A) is printed as '(A)- Ceramic, FRP, PP are smooth and require less water for flushing. FRP cheaper, lighter and easier to transport than the other' — it lacks a verb in 'FRP cheaper' and ends 'than the other' (singular); both retained as printed, not corrected.

Footnote (B) is printed as '(B)- The inlet pipe should project 100 mm in to the leach pit.A junction chamber of 250×250 mm should be provided in case of pipe' — printed 'in to' as two words and with no space after 'pit.'; retained as printed, not corrected.
Row 1 Squatting Pan prints the slope as '25 -28°' (space before the hyphen, none after); retained as printed.
Row 3 prints '(Pt. III)' without a space after the bracket in the Squatting Pan cell, but '( Pt. XIII)' and '( Pt. X)' with a space in the Trap and Footrests cells; retained as printed.
Row 4 Trap and Footrests cells are blank in the printed grid and are recorded as empty strings; the grid rules show they are separate cells, not one merged cell.
